title: Pretty darn perfect!!!!
text:
Pretty darn perfect!!!!. Love these- for the price you cannot go wrong. Wish I ordered the size up but will probably use both in 2 bedrooms- small as rugs. Probably one of my better purchases- have already had major compliments “ where did you find those?”
Great buy!!!
